mapper.sql: i.id, i.user_id, i.identity_type, i.identifier, i.display_name, i.origin, i.create_by, i.create_time
mapper.select: SELECT , u.nick_name, u.user_name, d.dept_name FROM sys_user_identity i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = i.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE i.id = #{id}

SELECT , u.nick_name, u.user_name, d.dept_name FROM sys_user_identity i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = i.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE i.identity_type = #{identityType} AND i.identifier = #{identifier} LIMIT 1

SELECT , u.nick_name, u.user_name, d.dept_name FROM sys_user_identity i LEFT JOIN sys_user u ON u.user_id = i.user_id LEFT JOIN sys_dept d ON d.dept_id = u.dept_id WHERE i.identity_type = #{identityType} ORDER BY i.user_id ASC, i.id ASC
